NATIONAL    CONSUMER    PRICE    INDEX   COMPUTED   BY   THE  DEPARTMENT   OF   CENSUS   AND
IT  is  hereby  notify  for  general  information  that  the  National  Consumer  Price  Index  computed  by  the  Department  of
Census and Statistics for the month of October 2019 was 131.9 (One Hundred and Thirty One Point Nine).
